prototype: Aluminum cantilever teaching rig with movable load hanger and dial gauge
checklist_source: Rig builders' published procedure, section 5, figure 7 and table 2, https://peer.asee.org/effective-use-of-an-undergraduate-research-fellowship-for-design-and-manufacture-of-tools-to-assist-in-teaching-strength-of-materials.pdf
candidate_pass_attribution: First response, repair and registry-guided refinement are not distinguished in the saved candidate records.
task: Students set up a hanger and dial gauge on this aluminum beam. Which changes to how they use the apparatus could affect the measured displacement? Compare with the single weight at the free end.
reviewer: Codex, retrospective comparison of the frozen builders' checklist with the separate post-repair batch

conditions.description: Hang the nominal test weight at B (half span) and read displacement at C (the free end).
conditions.review_reason: Credit for the numerical condition only. The saved controls move the same 3.47 N point load from the free end to half span. The solver reports 0.2572318134 mm maximum deflection. For this cantilever with a single transverse point load, displacement magnitude increases to the free end, so the maximum equals the required tip reading. The model selected a registered midspan load operation. Its draft incorrectly predicts a midspan gauge reading, and the run includes no gauge-position control.
conditions.quote: The students place the same total force at one point halfway between the clamp and the free tip.
conditions.candidate_reason: Measurements were recorded without an overall acceptance verdict.

conditions.description: Use the same weight at C, move the gauge to B and compare that reading with the first. Comparing two tip readings does not establish reciprocity.
conditions.review_reason: The prose mentions the correct gauge location but under the half-span load. The supplied tip-load reference reports its maximum at the tip (0.8231418028 mm). Neither side reports a gauge reading selected at half span under the full tip load, and the batch never compares the two reciprocal readings.
conditions.quote: The dial gauge will register the displacement at midspan
conditions.candidate_reason: Measurements were recorded without an overall acceptance verdict.

conditions.description: Keep the dial probe perpendicular to the beam and on its longitudinal centerline at each gauge position.
conditions.review_reason: A clarification asks about the beam being vertical and horizontal. It does not ask whether the probe is perpendicular to the beam or contacts the longitudinal centerline.

conditions.description: Set the gauge bracket to give approximately 1 mm of initial probe compression.
conditions.review_reason: No proposal or clarification addresses the gauge bracket setting or the initial 1 mm of probe compression.

interventions: The evaluator transcribed the rig builders' published procedure into a four-condition checklist before intake. No live operator of this rig took part.

The operator mapped the source to SI units using an equivalent square section that preserves the reported second moment of area and a nominal aluminum modulus of 70 GPa. The teaching experiment gives no numerical acceptance limit.
The operator resubmitted the ordinary brief and selected the original reference after repairs to the shared discovery workflow. The cold attempt and original completed retry are retained separately.
The reviewer identified where the reported global maximum occurs for this cantilever under a downward point force. No gauge-location selection was executed by the scenario batch.
